name: Beta Enerji ve Teknoloji A.S.
summary: Beta Enerji ve Teknoloji A.S. designs, manufactures and exports transformers and high-voltage (HV) switching products in Turkey and internationally. The company's products include power transformers, custom-wound transformers, oil-immersed distribution transformers, dry type transformers, earthing transformers, shunt reactors, metal-enclosed switchgear, circuit breakers and disconnectors, and Monoblock concrete kiosks. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Adana, Turkey. Beta Enerji ve Teknoloji A.S. operates as a subsidiary of TMD Finansal Danismanlik AS.
